Subject: Billing routing during Pivot holding company consolidation

Hi Aditya and Laura,

As discussed last week with legal, Pivot Systems is consolidating several subsidiaries under Pivot Holding Ltd. Our finance team needs to ensure invoice routing and VAT treatment during the transition (expected cutover week of Feb 21). Two ask items: 

1) Can Redwood continue to bill the four active child entities on their current PO numbers for another 30 days while remittance is updated?
2) We need an operational contact and a billing redirect so invoices for the child entities can be auto-forwarded to our new accounts-payable mailbox once the legal name change is live.

I've attached the holding-company instruction memo and a CSV with the initial remit mappings. Also looping in Marco from Acqui Legal so he can confirm whether the tax IDs in the memo are the final ones.

Attachments: Pivot_HoldingCo_Instructions.pdf, redirect_map.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if it helps.

Best,
Elena Ruiz

Hi Elena — thanks for the memo and CSV. Quick answers up front: yes, we can keep invoicing the existing child entities for 30 days while remits are updated, and we can set up a redirect rule to send PDFs to the new AP mailbox.

Operational notes / next steps (action items):
- Monica will own the redirect configuration in our billing system and validate PO continuity. (Monica: can you confirm acceptance criteria below?)
- Laura will coordinate collections cadence if any invoice delivery fails during the cutover.
- We need the final legal names + VAT IDs by Feb 18 to lock the tax treatment.

Acceptance criteria for the 30-day pass-through: 
- We receive a signed mandate (simple form) that authorizes invoices to be routed to Pivot Holding Ltd after cutover.
- The CSV columns must include: old_entity_name, old_tax_id, new_entity_name, new_tax_id, preferred_remit_email.

Elena — can Marco confirm the signed mandate timeline? If not, we can provisionally accept an attorney-signed confirmation, but finance will require the formal signed mandate before changing our ledger entries.

I'll set up a 20-minute working call for Friday to run through the CSV and the redirect mapping.

Thanks,

Thanks Marco — appreciated. Elena / Pivot team, looping back with the operations plan and a couple of clarifications so we can avoid interruptions to collections: 

1) Redirect implementation: We'll create an automatic routing rule that forwards invoice PDFs generated for the four child entities to the new AP mailbox (billing@pivot-systems.com). Routing will be active on Feb 22 in our staging tenant and live on Feb 23 after a short smoke test.

2) Ledger and tax change process: Per legal guidance, we will NOT change the invoice "bill-to" legal name in our produced PDFs until 30 days after we receive the signed mandate. During that 30-day window we will: 
  - Generate invoices with existing entity names but tag them internally as "Remit: Pivot Holding Ltd" so your AP team can reconcile.
  - Apply the new VAT treatment on our side (tax mapping to new VAT IDs) starting the invoice date that aligns with your effective cutover. This will be visible on our gross/net tax calculations in the invoice metadata.

3) Collections exceptions: If an invoice bounces or an automatic payment fails after the redirect is live, our collections team will send a single automated follow-up to the original child-entity PO contact and CC the new AP mailbox. If no resolution after 7 days, we'll escalate to Laura to coordinate a manual recovery plan.

4) Documents requested by Redwood Finance: please upload the signed mandate and the finalized CSV (with corrected VAT formatting) to the HubSpot attachment I linked here: https://hubspot.company.com/contacts/HS-23456 or reply with a DocuSign link.

Attachments: signed_mandate.pdf (pending — to be uploaded when signed)

I'll standby for the signed mandate on Tue Feb 16 and will proceed to schedule the staging smoke test once it's in. If you prefer a 15-minute runthrough instead of the 20-minute call, I'm available Feb 15 10:00-11:00 PT.

Thanks,
